regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, and article metadata
regions.finding: The paper reports PtCl2-catalyzed cyclization of 1-(indol-2-yl)-2,3-allenols with methyl or exclusive aryl migration. The Supporting Information availability statement does not establish an associated SI file in this workspace.
The text introduces a generic proposed Pt-carbene pathway and prior literature; Scheme 1 itself appears on page 2 and is classified as a mechanism rather than a reported experiment.

regions.region: page 1 lower-right Results and Discussion opening
regions.finding: The optimization study of 4,4-dimethyl allenol 5a is introduced and continues as Table 1 on page 2; no extra page-1-only experiment is created.

unresolved: No associated SI file is present; page 1 contains no complete experiment-specific conditions or outcomes.

regions.finding: Generic Pt-carbene M leading to alternative carbazoles 4A/4B; classified as a proposed mechanism, not an experiment.

regions.region: page 2 center, Table 1 reaction drawing, rows 1–13, and footnotes a–d
regions.finding: Thirteen independent optimization rows retained with catalyst/solvent, row-specific temperatures/loadings, NMR yield, recovery, and CH2Br2 internal-standard basis. Dashes remain source markers.
Narrative confirms the optimization outcomes and exposes an AgBF4-versus-AgOTf discrepancy for entry 2; this conflict is preserved in the row record.

regions.region: page 2 bottom-right, Scheme 2 and adjacent sentence
regions.finding: Two distinct substrates 5b and 5c each gave very-low-yield mixtures of two unassigned regioisomers; retained as separate partial records.

unresolved: Table 1 omits reaction times/scales and most workups; Scheme 2 omits numerical yields, products, and experiment-specific conditions.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left, Table 2 reaction drawing, rows 1–7, and footnote a
regions.finding: Seven independent aryl-migration scope rows retained with 0.4 mmol substrate, PtCl2 5 mol%, 2 mL toluene, nitrogen, row times, and isolated yields.
ORTEP structure of 6m supports the reported exclusive aryl migration but does not define an additional reaction experiment.

regions.region: page 3 lower half, Scheme 3 and DFT prose
regions.finding: Calculated methyl- versus phenyl-migration paths from Pt-carbene M retained as a mechanism record with printed activation and relative energies; not counted as a preparative experiment.

unresolved: Table 2 entry 3 prints m-MeOC6H4, whereas the page-6 experimental product title/formula support m-tolyl; the inconsistency remains unresolved.

regions.finding: Five separately specified substituted-allenol cyclizations (5k–5o) retained under shared PtCl2 5 mol%/toluene/r.t. conditions with yields 55–83%.

regions.region: page 4 left-center prose and bottom Scheme 5
regions.finding: Three no-reaction substrates 5p–5r, one 5s experiment giving 6p (3%) plus cycloisomerization product 8 (55%), and a protected-substrate 9 experiment giving 6p (5%) with 63% 9 recovery were retained separately.

regions.region: page 4 right column, Experimental Section and start of 5a typical procedure
regions.finding: The first stage of a two-stage preparation of 5a begins here and is merged with its continuation on page 5.

unresolved: Scheme 4 omits time/scale/yield basis; conditions for 5p–5r and protected substrate 9 are not explicitly stated.
No SI file was supplied or associated.

regions.region: page 5 upper-left, completion of 5a typical procedure
regions.finding: Two-stage lithiation/aldehyde addition followed by LiAlH4 reduction gives 5a in 51% combined isolated yield (0.7995 g); merged with page 4.

regions.region: page 5 lower-left and upper-right, 5g typical procedure and reaction arrows
regions.finding: Two-stage lithiation/aldehyde addition then CuBr/EtMgBr allene formation gives 5g in 40% combined yield (1.3587 g); retained as one multistage experiment.

regions.region: page 5 lower-right, start of 5l typical procedure and reaction arrows
regions.finding: Preparation of 5l begins with n-BuLi/aldehyde addition and CuCN/CH3MgBr; the workup and yield continue on page 6 and are merged there.

unresolved: Intermediates 7a and 7g have no separately reported isolated yields.
The 5l scheme loading (CuCN 5 mol%) differs from the printed 0.58 mmol on a 10 mmol scale.

regions.finding: CuCN/CH3MgBr stage, -30 °C/14 h, workup, purification, 1.0203 g product, and 40% combined yield complete the cross-page 5l record.

regions.region: page 6 left-center, typical carbazole procedure for 6a
regions.finding: Detailed 5a/PtCl2/toluene/N2 room-temperature 10 h run gives 6a in 73% isolated yield; linked to Table 1 entry 4 while preserving its separate 86% NMR outcome.

regions.region: page 6 lower-left and right column, preparations 6d–6h
regions.finding: Detailed quantities, times, solvent volumes, purification, masses, and isolated yields for 6d–6h were linked to Table 2 entries 1–5. Shared table scales conflict with detailed scales and both are retained.

unresolved: Table 2 says 0.4 mmol/2 mL for all rows, while detailed preparations use 0.19–0.30 mmol and 1.0–1.5 mL; source discrepancy unresolved.
The 6h characterization continues on page 7, which is outside the claimed coverage range.
